research_agent_prompt: This is the Cambridge-only fallback campaign for Pearson Edexcel Central Europe (triggered only if the Edexcel-primary outreach yields no positive replies). Produce a PART-8 strategic brief with four sections: School Profile, Recruitment Analysis, Candidate Match, and Contact Strategy. Do NOT write an outreach email (the cover-letter generator owns that). For School Profile summarise the institution's curriculum, location and hiring context. For Recruitment Analysis assess demand, visa/sponsorship posture and competition. For Candidate Match map Mahmoud's Pearson Edexcel IGCSE (4PH1) and A-Level Physics/Maths expertise to the role, bridging the school's Cambridge/IB Physics-Maths to Mahmoud's Edexcel via the ~90% content-overlap framing. For Contact Strategy recommend a concrete outreach channel and timing (Oct-Dec pre-peak for Aug starts). This is a SPECULATIVE prospecting campaign: there is no live vacancy. Research the institution as a real, geo-anchored target school and produce a brief that supports a proactive outreach email proposing a meeting or demo lesson in case a position opens soon.
